title: Sylicate
description: A super consistent client-side modpack designed to add comforts, features, and improve performance.
body:
# Sylicate

(*psy*-le-kate) is a client-side modpack designed by Zakarya to add comforts, features and improve performance. It is super consistent and all features are configured to fit in, match each other and generally feel "Minecraft-y". Some might say it's the "OCD modpack".

This modpack shouldn't feel too far from vanilla Minecraft.

This is the modpack that Zakarya uses in his videos/streams and on Turtlecraft.

### Keybinds:
- WASD: Movement
- C: Drop Item
- 12346789: Hotbar Slot 1|2|3|6|7|8|9
- Q: Hotbar Slot 5 (middle)
- E: Open/Close Inventory
- F: Swap Offhand
- BX: Load/Save Hotbar
- tab: List Players
- T: Open Chat
- /: Open Command
- J: Server Quick Actions
- f2: Take Screenshot
- f6: Toggle FPS Meter (MiniHUD)
- f11: Toggle Fullscreen
- R: Togggle Perspective
- 0: Builder Tool Slot (Axiom)
- left alt: Builder Context Menu (Axiom)
- right shift: Toggle Build Editor UI (Axiom)
- I: Toggle Barrel Roll mode (DaBR)
- WAD: Elytra Yaw & Thrust (DaBR)
- V: Voice Chat Menu (SVC)
- H: Hide Voice Chat Icons (SVC)
- G: Toggle Minimap Visibility (XMM)
- Z: Enlarge Minimap (XMM)
- =: Create New Waypoint (XMM)
- -: Create New Temporary Waypoint (XMM)
- N: Toggle In-World Waypoints (XMM)
- []: Zoom Minimap In/Out (XMM)
- M: Open World Map (XWM)
- mouse button 4: Zoom In (Zoomify)
- mouse button 4: Secondary Zoom (Zoomify)
- \: Toggle Easy Place (Litematica)
- left/right/up/down: Layer (Mode) Next/Previous (Litematica)
- ,: Schematic Main Menu (Litematica)
- mouse button 3: Pick Schematic Block (Litematica)
- P: Toggle Schematic Rendering
- U: Toggle Freecam
- `: Toggle Auto Hand Restock
- O: Sort Chest
